facts.text: Saxtons River likely got its name from a surveyor named Saxton who reportedly fell into the stream during early mapping in the 1750s.
Vermont Academy, a private high school founded in 1876, helped create New England's winter recreation culture through its annual Winter Carnival.
Saxtons River Falls, originally known as Middle Falls, features an eight-foot cascade that historically powered local mills and industries.
From 1900 to 1924, an electric train system called the Bellows Falls and Saxtons River Railroad linked the area's incorporated villages.
The Saxtons River Village Historic District was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1986 to preserve its 19th-century character.
By 1828, Saxtons River was a bustling hub with a post office, a tannery, a distillery, and various mills and stores.
